79007-founding-fathers.title: Founding Fathers
79007-founding-fathers.creator: Unknown
79007-founding-fathers.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ” John Hancock shrugged. “Well, whaddya expeck? Guy can’t even smoke, and these here britches are so tight I’m scared to sit down in ’em.” Thomas Jefferson turned and confronted him. “You ain’t gonna sit down,” he said. “All you gotta do is sign and keep your yap shut. Let Ben do the talking, remember?” “Ben?” “Benjamin Franklin, schmoe,” said Thomas Jefferson.

arxiv-1809-08888.title: Empirical Methodology for Crowdsourcing Ground Truth Volume: 1
arxiv-1809-08888.creator: Anca Dumitrache, Oana Inel, Benjamin Timmermans, Carlos Ortiz, Robert-Jan Sips, Lora Aroyo, Chris Welty
arxiv-1809-08888.description: Abstract The process of gathering ground truth data through human annotation is a major bottleneck in the use of information extraction methods for populating the Semantic Web. Crowdsourcing-based approaches are gaining popularity in the attempt to solve the issues related to volume of data and lack of annotators. Typically these practices use inter-annotator agreement as a measure of quality.

arxiv-2303-15741.title: Gamma rays from Nebulae around Recurrent Novae
arxiv-2303-15741.creator: W. Bednarek & J. Sitarek
arxiv-2303-15741.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by W. Bednarek & J. Sitarek. Novae were discovered to emit transient γ \gamma rays during the period of several days to a few weeks after initial explosion, indicating presence of acceleration processes of particles in their expanding shells. In the case of recurrent novae, electrons can be in principle accelerated in the nova shells for the whole recurrence period of nova producing delayed γ \gamma ray emission as considered in Bednarek (2022).

arxiv-2304-09167.title: Optimal PAC Bounds Without Uniform Convergence
arxiv-2304-09167.creator: Ishaq Aden-Ali, Yeshwanth Cherapanamjeri, Abhishek Shetty, Nikita Zhivotovskiy
arxiv-2304-09167.description: Abstract In statistical learning theory, determining the sample complexity of realizable binary classification for VC classes was a long-standing open problem. The results of Simon [ 49 ] and Hanneke [ 22 ] established sharp upper bounds in this setting.

arxiv-2305-00842.title: Estimating the properties of single positive air streamers from measurable parameters
arxiv-2305-00842.creator: Dennis Bouwman, Hani Francisco, Ute Ebert
arxiv-2305-00842.description: Abstract We develop an axial model for single steadily propagating positive streamers in air. It uses observable parameters to estimate quantities that are difficult to measure. More specifically, for given velocity, radius, length and applied background field, our model approximates the ionization density, the maximal electric field, the channel electric field, and the width of the charge layer.

arxiv-2310-01461.title: Awkward Just-In-Time (JIT) Compilation:
arxiv-2310-01461.creator: \firstname Ianna \lastname Osborne \fnsep, \firstname Jim \lastname Pivarski, \firstname Ioana \lastname Ifrim, \firstname Angus \lastname Hollands, \firstname Henry \lastname Schreiner
arxiv-2310-01461.description: Abstract Awkward Array is a library for performing NumPy-like computations on nested, variable-sized data, enabling array-oriented programming on arbitrary data structures in Python. However, imperative (procedural) solutions can sometimes be easier to write or faster to run. Performant imperative programming requires compilation; JIT-compilation makes it convenient to compile in an interactive Python environment.

arxiv-2505-18360.title: Neutral-Hosts In The Shared Mid-Bands: Addressing Indoor Cellular Performance
arxiv-2505-18360.creator: Muhammad Iqbal Rochman 1 , Joshua Roy Palathinkal 1 , Vanlin Sathya 2 , Mehmet Yavuz 2 , and Monisha Ghosh 1
arxiv-2505-18360.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Muhammad Iqbal Rochman 1 , Joshua Roy Palathinkal 1 , Vanlin Sathya 2 , Mehmet Yavuz 2 , and Monisha Ghosh 1. The 3.55 - 3.7 GHz Citizens Broadband Radio Service (CBRS) band in the U.S., shared with incumbent Navy radars, is witnessing increasing deployments both indoors and outdoors using a shared, licensed model.

arxiv-2506-09945.title: A Diffuse-Interface Marangoni Instability
arxiv-2506-09945.creator: Xiangwei Li 1, Dongdong Wan 2, Haohao Hao 1, Christian Diddens 3, Mengqi Zhang 2, Huanshu Tan 1
arxiv-2506-09945.description: Abstract We investigate a novel Marangoni-induced instability that arises exclusively in diffuse fluid interfaces, absent in classical sharp-interface models. Using a validated phase-field Navier–Stokes–Allen–Cahn framework, we linearize the governing equations to analyze the onset and development of interfacial instability driven by solute-induced surface tension gradients.

arxiv-2509-20239.title: Error Propagation in Dynamic Programming: From Stochastic Control to Option Pricing
arxiv-2509-20239.creator: Andrea Della Vecchia, Damir Filipović
arxiv-2509-20239.description: Abstract This paper investigates theoretical and methodological foundations for stochastic optimal control (SOC) in discrete time. We start formulating the control problem in a general dynamic programming framework, introducing the mathematical structure needed for a detailed convergence analysis. The associate value function is estimated through a sequence of approximations combining nonparametric regression methods and Monte Carlo subsampling.

arxiv-2510-20185.title: Unexpected Near-Resonant and Metastable States of Young Multi-Planet Systems
arxiv-2510-20185.creator: Zhecheng Hu (胡哲程), Fei Dai (戴飞), Wei Zhu (祝伟), Mu-Tian Wang (王牧天), Max Goldberg, Caleb Lammers, Kento Masuda (増田賢人)
arxiv-2510-20185.description: Abstract Recent observations suggest that the incidence of near-resonant planets declines as planetary systems age, making young planetary systems key signposts of early dynamical evolution. Here we investigate the dynamical states of three of the youngest multi-transiting planetary systems: AU Mic (3-planet, ∼ \sim 20-Myr-old), V1298 Tau (4-planet, ∼ \sim 23-Myr-old), and TOI-2076 (4-planet, ∼ \sim 200-Myr-old).

arxiv-2601-16057.title: Constraining Nuclear Molecular Gas Content with High-resolution CO Imaging of GOALS Galaxies
arxiv-2601-16057.creator: James Agostino, Anne M. Medling, Loreto Barcos-Muñoz, Vivian U, Mynor Rodríguez Vásquez, George C. Privon, Claudia Cicone, Lee Armus, Jorge Moreno, Claudio Ricci, Yiqing Song, Christopher C. Hayward, Katherine Alatalo, David B. Sanders
arxiv-2601-16057.description: Abstract We present measurements of the cool molecular gas mass around the nuclei of two gas-rich mergers, III Zw 035 and IRAS F01364 − - 1042, whose enclosed masses (M enc ) within the central 40-80 pc would be overmassive if attributed entirely to the supermassive black hole mass (SMBH) and compared to SMBH-galaxy scaling relations.

arxiv-2602-19158.title: DoAtlas-1: A Causal Compilation Paradigm for Clinical AI
arxiv-2602-19158.creator: Yulong Li, Jianxu Chen, Xiwei Liu, Chuanyue Suo, Rong Xia, Zhixiang Lu, Yichen Li, Xinlin Zhuang, Niranjana Arun Menon, Yutong Xie, Eran Segal, Imran Razzak
arxiv-2602-19158.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yulong Li, Jianxu Chen, Xiwei Liu, Chuanyue Suo, Rong Xia, Zhixiang Lu, Yichen Li, Xinlin Zhuang, Niranjana Arun Menon, Yutong Xie, Eran Segal, Imran Razzak. Medical foundation models generate narrative explanations but cannot quantify intervention effects, detect evidence conflicts, or validate literature claims, limiting clinical auditability. We propose causal compilation , a paradigm that transforms medical evidence from narrative text into executable code.

pmc-10654151.title: Alkali metals doped cycloparaphenylene nanohoops: Promising nonlinear optical materials with enhanced performance
pmc-10654151.creator: Ruqiya Rasul, Tariq Mahmood, Khurshid Ayub, Khurram Saleem Joya, Farooq Anwar, Nazamid Saari, R Nawaz, Mazhar Amjad Gilani
pmc-10654151.description: In the ongoing pursuit of novel and efficient NLO materials, the potential of alkali metal-doped {6}cycloparaphenylene ({6}CPP) and methylene bridged {6} cycloparaphenylene (MB{6}CPP) nanohoops as excellent NLO candidates has been explored. The geometric, electronic, linear, and nonlinear optical properties of designed systems have been investigated theoretically. All the nanohoops demonstrated thermodynamic stability, with remarkable interaction energies reaching up to −1.

pmc-10720340.title: Probing the Local Structure of Na in NaNO3-Promoted, MgO-Based CO2 Sorbents via X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy
pmc-10720340.creator: Margarita Rekhtina, Aram Bugaev, Matthew T Dunstan, Alessandro Dal Pozzo, Manouchehr Nadjafi, Camelia Borca, Thomas Huthwelker, Paula M Abdala, Christoph R Müller
pmc-10720340.description: This work provides insight into the local structure of Na in MgO-based CO2 sorbents that are promoted with NaNO3. To this end, we use X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) at the Na K-edge to interrogate the local structure of Na during the CO2 capture (MgO + CO2 ↔ MgCO3).

pmc-10737362.title: HAVING A SENSE OF PURPOSE IN LIFE AS A PROTECTIVE FACTOR FOR COGNITIVE DECLINE IN LATER ADULTHOOD
pmc-10737362.creator: Giyeon Kim
pmc-10737362.description: The purpose of this symposium presentation is to discuss the role of having a sense of purpose in life in protecting against cognitive decline in later adulthood. The speaker presents recent findings on purpose in life as a protective factor for cognitive decline from a nationally representative sample of older adults.

pmc-11507656.title: Research Progress on Genomic Regions and Candidate Genes Related to Milk Composition Traits of Dairy Goats Based on Functional Genomics: A Narrative Review
pmc-11507656.creator: Xu Yang, Qing Li, Yanyan Wang, Jianmin Wang, Jiaqing Hu, Zhibin Ji, Tianle Chao
pmc-11507656.description: Background: Goat milk has gained global attention for its unique nutritional properties and potential health benefits. Advancements in functional genomic technologies have significantly progressed genetic research on milk composition traits in dairy goats. Results: This review summarizes various research methodologies applied in this field.

pmc-11615531.title: A dataset of 40 assembled and annotated transcriptomes from 34 species in Silene and related genera
pmc-11615531.creator: Patrik Cangren, Yann JK Bertrand, John M Braverman, Gregor Duncan Gilfillan, Matthew B Hamilton, Bengt Oxelman
pmc-11615531.description: A dataset of 40 assembled and annotated transcriptomes from 34 different species sampled from phylogenetically diverse parts of the flowering plant genus Silene (Caryophyllaceae) and the related genera Agrostemma, Atocion, Eudianthe, Heliosperma, Petrocoptis and Viscaria. RNA extracted from roots, stems, leaves, buds and flowers were sequenced using paired end reads on the Illumina Hiseq platform.

pmc-11652013.title: An improved multi-scale feature extraction network for medical image segmentation
pmc-11652013.creator: Haoyu Guo, Liuliu Shi, Jinlong Liu
pmc-11652013.description: BackgroundThe use of U-Net and its variations has led to significant advancements in medical image segmentation. However, the encoder-decoder structures of these models often lose spatial information during downsampling. Skip connections can help address this issue; however, they may also introduce excessive irrelevant background information.

pmc-12737489.title: Vaccine Attitudes Among Adults in a Southern European Region: Survey from Pre- to Post-COVID-19
pmc-12737489.creator: Myrian Pichiule-Castañeda, Alicia Serrano-de-la-Cruz, María-Felícitas Domínguez-Berjón, Ana Gandarillas-Grande, Vincenzo Baldo
pmc-12737489.description: Background: Vaccine hesitancy and refusal are growing public health challenges, reflecting individual decisions and social inequalities. The COVID-19 pandemic reshaped vaccine perceptions and may have amplified pre-existing differences. This study analyzed the evolution of vaccine hesitancy and refusal among adults in the Community of Madrid (Spain) between 2019 and 2024. We also explored the associated sociodemographic profiles.

pmc-12784887.title: Molecular Characterization and Epidemiology of Anaplasmataceae in Ticks and Domestic Animals in the Colombian Caribbean
pmc-12784887.creator: Maria Badillo-Viloria, Ignacio García-Bocanegra, Steffania de la Rosa Jaramillo, Salim Mattar, Mario Frías-Casas, David Cano-Terriza
pmc-12784887.description: Simple SummaryTick-borne diseases represent a significant threat to both animal and public health, especially in tropical regions. Little is known about the epidemiology of these diseases in domestic animals and ticks in the Colombian Caribbean. To investigate infections caused by Anaplasmataceae bacteria, this study examined 1156 ticks and blood samples collected from 56 cattle and 17 equids in northern Colombia.

pmc-12958141.title: Depression and anxiety symptoms among women in post-conflict Somalia: a cross-sectional study in maternal and child health centres
pmc-12958141.creator: Gallad D. Hassan, Juweria N. L. Abshir, Fatumo Osman
pmc-12958141.description: ObjectiveMental health issues can be regarded as a severe public health problem that affects low-, middle-, and high-income countries worldwide. However, certain populations in post-conflict countries may have particularly vulnerable mental health, such as women of childbearing age in Somalia.

pmc-13039898.title: Aescin and rutin mitigate hyperthyroidism-induced multisystem dysfunction via antioxidant and anti-inflammatory mechanisms in a rat model
pmc-13039898.creator: Minnatullah A. Makadi, Ibrahim A. Ibrahim, Hoda I. Bahr, Amr Elkelish, Zongo Oumarou, Hassan Rudayni, Amal A. M. Ahmed, Yasmina K. Mahmoud
pmc-13039898.description: Hyperthyroidism triggers systemic complications, including oxidative stress, dyslipidemia, hepatic injury, insulin resistance, and cardiovascular dysfunction. Conventional treatments such as Propylthiouracil (PTU) often exhibit adverse effects, highlighting the need for safer alternatives. We evaluated the therapeutic efficacy of the natural bioactives aescin and rutin, alone and in combination with PTU, in L-thyroxine–induced hyperthyroid rats.

pmc-13300349.title: Conduction behaviour of deceleration zones identified during substrate mapping for ventricular tachycardia using S1-S2-S3 protocol
pmc-13300349.creator: J Reventos-Presmanes, N Pierucci, J B Guichard, T Rosseel, M Regany, J M Tolosana, E Guasch, L Mont, J Brugada, E Arbelo, I Roca, A Porta-Sanchez
pmc-13300349.description: BackgroundProgrammed stimulation reveals dynamic conduction behaviour in ventricular tachycardia (VT) substrates. As coupling intervals shorten, regions near scar may show decrement or unidirectional block, reflecting local excitability and refractoriness. These responses define functional boundaries of reentry, yet their characterization during mapping remains largely qualitative.

pmc-13381539.title: Differentiable land model reveals global environmental controls on latent ecological functions
pmc-13381539.creator: Jianing Fang, Kevin Bowman, Wenli Zhao, Xu Lian, Pierre Gentine
pmc-13381539.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The spatial distributions of plant functional traits observed today are living imprints of current environmental gradients and past selection, offering insight into how plants have adapted to their environments. What remains insufficiently understood is how traits combine and coordinate across environments, and whether such coordination reflects organizing principles in ecology that can improve modeling of ecosystem functional diversity and decadal-scale carbon exchange.

pmc-13424269.title: Enrichment of a mixed microbial culture for PHA production with used cooking oil as substrate
pmc-13424269.creator: C Ucha, D Correa-Galeote, A Val del Rio, A Pedrouso, A Mosquera-Corral
pmc-13424269.description: The synthesis of polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA) by a mixed microbial culture (MMC) employing used cooking oil (UCO) as substrate represents a promising bioprocess for organic wastes valorisation. In this study, MMC enrichment in a sequencing batch reactor (SBR) was investigated using UCO without pretreatment as the sole carbon source.
